projects.name: Telstra OM+
projects.overview: Worked on Telstra's Order Manager Plus platform supporting telecom order orchestration across Mobile, Fixed, and Energy services. The platform manages the complete customer order lifecycle from qualification through provisioning.
responsibilities: Developed OmniStudio FlexCards for telecom order lifecycle management.
Built reusable Salesforce solutions for order visibility.
Designed a bulkified Apex trigger framework for high-volume telecom order lifecycle transactions.
Developed Flow-based eligibility validations and orchestration for order hold and resume processes.
Participated in Agile ceremonies and sprint planning.
Collaborated with business analysts and solution architects.
achievements: Reduced L1 service tickets by 25% through AI-powered self-service.
Ensured only qualified orders reached provisioning systems.

projects.name: Unum OS
projects.overview: Worked on Unum's insurance operations platform supporting policy management and claims processing, with focus on automation, compliance, data quality, and secure access management.
responsibilities: Developed Batch Apex processes for large-scale insurance policy data processing.
Implemented Service Cloud automation for claims workflows.
Managed permission sets and sharing models.
achievements: Migrated 50,000+ legacy policy records using Data Loader.
Improved data quality, reliability, and historical availability.
Enforced secure region-based and role-based data access.
